Message.Name: Quotes And Bbo5 Message
Message.Description: A Quotes & BBO5 message indicates the modification of one or more of the N best limits (N being the number of limits disseminated for the given exchange 1 ) for an instrument and, during the Pre-Opening phase, the modification of the "market summary" for the instrument

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the instrument

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the message generation time

Field.Name: AskPrice
Field.Description: Ask Price for Quote or BBO (To be calculated with the ScaleCode) Specific values: '0' - Limit Deletion 'FF FF FF FE ' - Market Order or Market To Limit Order

Field.Name: AskSize
Field.Description: Total number of shares requested in sell orders at the ask price

Field.Name: BidPrice
Field.Description: Bid Price for Quote or BBO (To be calculated with the ScaleCode) Specific values: '0' - Limit Deletion 'FF FF FF FE ' - Market Order or Market To Limit Order

Field.Name: BidSize
Field.Description: Total number of securities requested in buy orders at the bid price

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: NumberAskOrders
Field.Description: Number of sell orders at the ask price

Field.Name: NumberBidOrders
Field.Description: Number of buy orders at the bid price Set to 1 when QuoteNumber is equal to 0 (Market Summary)

Field.Name: QuoteCondition
Field.Description: Liquidity provider presence indicator, only provided for instruments traded on a LP quote driven book

Field.Name: QuoteNumber
Field.Description: Indicates the level in the order book for the given aggregate quote, derived from it's price value

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: Applicable to all prices in the message
